text.brief: At 2:15 a.m. in the autumn of 2033, a watch officer in Taipei sees a swarm of small drones rise from a cargo ship in Keelung harbor. Twenty minutes later a video of Taiwan's president announcing a ceasefire plays on every mainland platform, and the president is still asleep.
text.record: Taiwan's courts have convicted presidential guards of spying for the People's Republic. The PLA fielded large numbers of drones and unmanned systems at its parade of September 3, 2025. Taiwan passed a six-year drone procurement act in August 2026 ([AEI](https://www.aei.org/commentary/china-taiwan-update-august-28-2026/)).
text.reading: The Party aims the first night at the people who decide. Drones, agents and a synthetic surrender message try to leave the island without a voice before its forces move. If the voice survives, the operation fails. This is Stratagem 18, capture the ringleader to disband the bandits.
text.coreEvent: The PLA attempts a strike on Taiwan's national leadership before 2036.
text.gapText: Architecture Governance. Taiwan's line of command runs through a few buildings and a few people, and no tested procedure proves who speaks for the state after a strike.
text.fix: Write the succession in law, spread it across places and people, and give every citizen a way to verify a real order.
